headline: Prime-angle SSE but small and onshore — fun early, then it's Tuesday you want.
today: Prime SSE angle at a workable head-high-ish size, but the S onshore is on it from dawn. Get there early for the cleanest of it around the morning low before the wind stacks up through midday. Longboard or groveler — decent for a summer Sunday, nothing more.

daysToWatch.note: Big one — up to head-and-a-half on a prime SSE angle at 7s. Downside is 16-20mph cross-on all day, so it'll be lumpy but rideable for the shortboard if you can find a sheltered corner.
The day to rearrange plans. Overhead prime swell with NNW offshore at dawn going NW cross-off through morning — clean and solid. Shortboard, and be there early before the afternoon cross-on.
Worth a look — chest-to-head-high with light W/WSW cross wind holding through the morning. Cleaner than midweek, groveler-friendly.
